Accounting_Audit.Trust Deed: Establishing trust deed or deed of variation/amendment; SMSF governing rules.
Accounting_Audit.Change of trustee document: Deed/minutes/notifications changing the fund's trustee (incl. ATO/ASIC change advices).
Accounting_Audit.ATO Trustee Declaration: ATO trustee/director declaration (NAT 71089) attesting understanding of SMSF duties.
Accounting_Audit.Investment Strategy: The fund's written investment strategy document.
Accounting_Audit.ASIC Statement/Extract: ASIC company-register extract / company statement (ACN, officeholders, share structure). Not an ASIC fee invoice.
Accounting_Audit.Death Benefit Nomination: Binding or non-binding death benefit nomination forms.
Accounting_Audit.Member Joined or Left during the year: Evidence of a member joining or exiting (membership application, exit/cessation advice).
Accounting_Audit.Prior Year Documents: Finalised/signed prior-year deliverables: signed financials, member statement, annual return, audit report & management letter, contravention report; and prior-year-only records. EXCEPTION: live ATO/super account snapshots stay in ATO Accounts.
Accounting_Audit.Bank & Term Deposits: Periodic bank account statements (period + balances + transaction list, BSB/acct no.), term-deposit certificates, and standalone bank interest reports/summaries.
Accounting_Audit.Wrap - Annual Transaction Listing and Po: Platform/wrap/private-bank consolidated investor statement: holdings/valuation as at 30 June and/or transaction/cash-ledger listing (e.g. HUB24 Annual Investor Statement, or a Macquarie Private Bank portfolio valuation + cash ledger report). Issuers are non-exhaustive - any investment platform or private-bank investment service qualifies.
Accounting_Audit.Wrap - Annual Tax Statement Report: Platform/wrap annual tax statement bundling tax summary, income, dividends, distributions, CGT (e.g. HUB24/UBS Annual Tax Statement / FY tax guide).
Accounting_Audit.Wrap - Type 2 Audit Report: Platform controls-assurance report (GS007/ASAE 3402 Type 2), or an independent review/assurance letter accompanying a platform's tax reports.
Accounting_Audit.Broker - Transaction Listing and Portfol: Broker-issued consolidated transaction ledger and/or holdings valuation (e.g. Ord Minnett). Not a wrap pack; not a single contract note.
Accounting_Audit.HIN Holding Statement: Broker/sponsor HIN holding statement for listed securities.
Accounting_Audit.Trade Contract: Buy/sell contract note for a security trade.
Accounting_Audit.Dividend Statement: A company's dividend advice for a direct shareholding (franking details).
Accounting_Audit.Distribution Statement: ANY periodic statement issued directly by a managed fund/trust (not a wrap/platform) for a single fund holding - covers pure distribution/income notices AND a general 'Periodic Statement' that also shows unit valuation, transaction history and fees for that one fund. It does NOT need to be a distribution-only notice to qualify; do not reject this category just because the document also includes a valuation/transaction summary.
Accounting_Audit.Annual Tax Statement: An individual managed fund/trust annual (AMIT/AMMA) tax statement for a direct holding - NOT via a wrap platform.
Accounting_Audit.Derivatives: Derivative transaction listings & buy/sell contracts; open position & valuation as at 30 June; Derivative Risk Management Statement.
Accounting_Audit.Unlisted Trust or Company: Unlisted/private investment docs: share/unit certificates, related-party/Part 8 associate trustee declarations, unlisted investee financials, capital-return/distribution notices.
Accounting_Audit.Investment in Real Property: Property docs: title search, purchase/sale contract, settlement statement, rental statements, lease, valuation/appraisal, water/council/strata/land-tax invoices, PROPERTY insurance, depreciation schedule.
Accounting_Audit.LRBA: Fund-as-borrower limited recourse borrowing: bare trust document, loan statement, loan agreement.
Accounting_Audit.Loan Given by the SMSF: Fund-as-lender: loan agreement and related loan statements.
Accounting_Audit.Gold/Silver bullion: Bullion purchase/sell documents and holding statements.
Accounting_Audit.ATO Accounts: ATO-issued account docs: income tax account, integrated client account, PAYG instalment report, GST BAS & Activity Statement, or a Total Superannuation Balance (TSB) / TBC report. A document titled or primarily a TSB statement belongs here EVEN THOUGH it references contribution caps/eligibility. Live snapshots showing only prior-year data stay here. Decide contributions-vs-TSB by the headline subject/title (see playbook rule 4).
Accounting_Audit.Contribution: Member contribution evidence & forms: notice of intent, co-contribution/LISTO remittance, CGT election cap, splitting, reserve adjustment, downsizer; payslips evidencing super; and ATO online-services screens whose headline subject is concessional/non-concessional CONTRIBUTIONS received and cap usage - these are Contribution even though they also show the member's TSB. A standalone TSB report is NOT a Contribution (see playbook rule 4).
Accounting_Audit.Benefit paid/transferred: Rollover benefit statement, pension commencement/commutation docs, PAYG payment summary, MEMBER insurance premium document (life/TPD/IP).
Accounting_Audit.Other Expenses: Fund expense invoices: accounting & audit fee invoices, adviser fee invoices, audit-shield fees, ASIC annual-review fees, investment/management fee notices & rebates. An accountant's 'Statement of Account'/'Activity Statement' belongs here.

Accounting.Prior Year Documents: Finalised/signed prior-year deliverables and prior-year-only records.
Accounting.Bank & Term Deposits: Periodic bank statements, term-deposit certificates, and standalone bank interest reports.
Accounting.Wrap - Annual Transaction Listing and Po: Platform/wrap/private-bank consolidated investor statement: holdings/valuation and/or transaction/cash-ledger listing (e.g. HUB24, or a Macquarie Private Bank portfolio valuation + cash ledger report). Issuers are non-exhaustive.
Accounting.Wrap - Annual Tax Statement Report: Platform annual tax statement (tax summary, income, distributions, CGT).
Accounting.Broker - Transaction Listing and Portfol: Broker consolidated transaction ledger and/or holdings valuation.
Accounting.HIN Holding Statement: HIN holding statement for listed securities.
Accounting.Trade Contract: Buy/sell contract note for a security trade.
Accounting.Dividend Statement: Company dividend advice for a direct shareholding.
Accounting.Distribution Statement: ANY periodic statement issued directly by a managed fund/trust (not a wrap/platform) for a single fund holding - covers pure distribution/income notices AND a general 'Periodic Statement' that also shows unit valuation, transaction history and fees for that one fund. It does NOT need to be a distribution-only notice to qualify; do not reject this category just because the document also includes a valuation/transaction summary.
Accounting.Annual Tax Statement: Individual managed fund/trust annual (AMIT/AMMA) tax statement.
Accounting.Unlisted Trust or Company: Unlisted/private investment docs incl. certificates and unlisted financials.
Accounting.Investment in Real Property: Property docs: contracts, rental, rates, valuations, depreciation.
Accounting.ATO Accounts: ATO income tax / integrated client / PAYG / GST BAS / TSB / TBC docs. A TSB report belongs here even though it references contribution caps (see playbook rule 4).
Accounting.Contribution: Member contribution evidence, forms, and ATO screens whose headline subject is concessional/non-concessional CONTRIBUTIONS received & cap usage (Contribution even if it shows TSB; a standalone TSB report is ATO Accounts - see playbook rule 4).
Accounting.Benefit paid/transferred: Rollovers, pension docs, PAYG payment summary, member insurance premium docs.
Accounting.Other Expenses: Accounting/adviser fee invoices, audit-shield, ASIC fees, management fees & rebates.
